channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: Nine Songs: Hildur Guðnadóttir
item.description: Ahead of her Barbican performance in March, Hildur Guðnadóttir talks BEST FIT through the songs that have soundtracked her life.

item.title: Robin Katz reveals new record Hypnos, inspired by "a life spent listening to Django Reinhardt and Philip Glass"
item.description: Guitarist and composer Robin Katz – who has collaborated with the likes of Disclosure, Reuben James and the London Django Collective – has announced new album Hypnos – a record he describes as "a brief slumberous escape from the madness out there" – alongside lead track "The Moon".

item.title: Brut Thoughts is Murkage Dave's sharpest work to date
item.description: Brut Thoughts feels like the kind of document we have been missing since the height of indie sleaze, not because Murkage Dave mimics that era, but because he's restoring its function: pop-adjacent culture as reportage.

item.title: Justice join Angèle for rare collaboration on new single, “What You Want”
item.description: Belgian pop singer Angèle has shared new single, “What You Want”, featuring electronic duo Justice.

item.title: Wax Head detail debut album, GNAT
item.description: Psych-punk quartet Wax Head have announced their debut album, GNAT, and shared new single “Bug Doctor”.

item.title: Oasis to feature on War Child HELP(2) album with live version of “Acquiesce”
item.description: War Child Records has announced that Oasis will feature on the upcoming HELP(2) album with an exclusive live version of “Acquiesce”, captured at Wembley Stadium on 28 September 2025.

item.title: Ivy Knight’s “Swimming In Blood” reimagines classic American songwriting for the new age
item.description: Inspired by sweeping landscapes, Oakland-raised, Brooklyn-based singer-songwriter Ivy Knight reshapes great American folk and country for her own contemporary sound.

item.title: "Protect creation from pride": Maya Hawke announces fourth album Maitreya Corso
item.description: Mom + Pop-signed actress and singer Maya Hawke has revealed her fourth album Maitreya Corso for a 1 May release, along with new single “Devil You Know”, a song about "trying to keep ambition and greed out of the creative process.”

item.title: Karl Ove Knausgård and the rhythm of language
item.description: Ahead of the Norwegian author's ambitious Historia event, Karl Ove Knausgård tells Best Fit how the music he grew up listening to continues to permeate his work.

item.title: Hana Lili, Betsan, Worldcub and more among 60 artists added to line-up for FOCUS Wales 2026
item.description: Following two previous waves of artist announcements, FOCUS Wales has revealed the next 60 names joining the line-up for the festival’s 2026 edition, taking place in Wrexham between 7-9 May.
